intro: First Mate Crazz of the Blackwater Raiders needs an adventurer to investigate rumors of rival pirates. With his crew busy drinking and chasing company in Booty Bay, he asks you to scout a nearby cove along the Savage Coast for signs of the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You sure seem eager to work, matey. Not sure why some land-loving traveler adventurer is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.
Our ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.
All the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies! What I need is a scout.
Check the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: On top of the barrel, you discover a map with some hastily written text on it along with some coins.
